# Synthetic dictation corpus.
#
# All phrases are constructed. They describe no real person and contain no
# patient information. Do not add real dictation to this file -- it is tracked
# in git.
#
# Phrases 001-005 are identical to baseline_phrases.txt so the real-voice
# baseline stays directly comparable to the synthetic one already measured.
#
# Categories follow CLAUDE.md section 6, Phase 6.

# --- 001-005: original baseline set (do not reorder) ---
The patient reports three days of dysuria and left flank pain.
Blood cultures grew methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus.
The differential includes pyelonephritis, nephrolithiasis, and musculoskeletal pain.
Continue cefazolin two grams intravenously every eight hours.
There is no evidence of endocarditis on transthoracic echocardiography.

# --- negation ---
The patient does not report fever, chills, or night sweats.
Repeat blood cultures remain negative at seventy-two hours.
There is no radiographic evidence of osteomyelitis.

# --- uncertainty and attribution ---
This may represent contaminant bacteremia rather than true infection.
Osteomyelitis remains possible but unconfirmed on current imaging.
The patient reports that the outside records indicate a penicillin allergy.

# --- medication, dose, route, frequency ---
Reduce vancomycin to one gram intravenously every twelve hours.
Start piperacillin-tazobactam four point five grams every six hours.
Continue trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole one double-strength tablet twice daily.
Transition to oral linezolid six hundred milligrams every twelve hours.

# --- organisms ---
The isolate was identified as Enterococcus faecium, vancomycin-resistant.
Cultures grew Pseudomonas aeruginosa susceptible to cefepime.
Stool testing was positive for Clostridioides difficile toxin.
Bronchoalveolar lavage demonstrated Pneumocystis jirovecii.

# --- numbers, units, laboratory values ---
The creatinine increased from zero point nine to one point four milligrams per deciliter.
The temperature was thirty-eight point two degrees Celsius.
The white blood cell count fell from eighteen thousand to nine thousand.
C-reactive protein declined from two hundred ten to forty-five.

# --- laterality and anatomy ---
There is erythema of the left lower extremity extending to the mid calf.
The right knee is more swollen than the left.
Imaging showed a fluid collection anterior to the right psoas muscle.

# --- ambiguous abbreviations (must NOT be expanded) ---
The patient will follow up with PT next week.
The outside note lists MS in the past medical history.
The consult question concerns PCP prophylaxis.

# --- research and statistical terminology ---
We fit a Bayesian hierarchical model with a beta-binomial likelihood.
The analysis used whole-genome sequencing and pairwise genetic relatedness.
The posterior predictive check showed adequate calibration across strata.
Isolates within five single nucleotide polymorphisms were considered linked.
